items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Jess Williams, he had a band.

ctx.x: Who else would come through Washington while you were there?

All the bands, Fletcher Henderson would come through there, Chick Webb, some bands from Middle West would come through and play, Zack White, and he had a popular band back in those days, and there was an old guy out of New York, Jess Williams, he had a band.
